decisions.decision: VRP percentile now ranks against ~10yr (config.VRP_DEEP_LOOKBACK_SESSIONS=2500, +40-day fetch buffer) instead of a rolling 252-session (~1yr) window
decisions.rationale: A short rolling window can only say a value is 'cheap' relative to a recent, possibly still-elevated regime — user's exact objection. CBOE vol-index actually holds decades of history (VIX to 1990, VXN/RVX to 2009) that was going unused because the RV20 alignment fetch was hardcoded to 400 days.

decisions.decision: Skew (25Δ) card field now states 'puts pricier'/'calls pricier'/'flat' instead of a bare signed number
decisions.rationale: put_iv - call_iv sign convention isn't self-evident; user asked directly whether puts or calls were rich relative to each other.

decisions.decision: CLAUDE.md's 'no new signals... locked until team validates' constraint reworded to drop the organizational-approval framing, keep the self-imposed statistical-validation discipline
